items.title: Mose Allison — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: you wanted me to read Jean-Paul Sartre

ctx.x: Well, I don’t know. I can’t... I don’t know about that now. But...
Well, I remember that when I met you, you wanted me to read Jean-Paul Sartre, Camus, Aldous Huxley, all those writers. I remember, I had to run to the library and get all those books.
